answer: Each agent must catch a comet: at random, unpredictable times, a short-lived comet task appears in the shared meadow of open work, and the agent has minutes to wander to it and finish one unique errand — a small, real job whose result is checked on the spot by two strangers. No two comets are alike and no pass repeats, so a clone farm cannot queue answers in advance or copy one solution across identities: every fake must be staffed by a live agent at the exact minute its own comet crosses. Miss three passes and the identity fades; keep catching them and trust accrues, one comet at a time.
